A plain resubmission does not come here; it uses the customer's own submit_referral in that job. When the job starts from this handoff: keep the verification already logged, and skip ask_verification through log_verification. Reuse the get_referrals and get_time results already read, and read them again only if they are missing. Take card_name from the card type on the REJECTED referral record. Give the tool only if all three pass; otherwise follow explain_no_program or explain_auto_reject.
